overrides.tagline: See products in 3D before you buy them
overrides.summary: An augmented reality shopping platform that lets users visualise products in 3D before purchase — built with React and AR.js.
description: Shopping online leaves people guessing about size and fit. AR Mart lets shoppers see products in 3D, in augmented reality, before they buy.
It's built with React for the shopping experience and AR.js for augmented reality in the browser.

features.title: 3D product preview
features.desc: Products shown as 3D models rather than flat photos.

features.title: Augmented reality
features.desc: AR.js places products in the shopper's surroundings through the camera.

features.title: In the browser
features.desc: A React web app — nothing to install.

challenge: Online shoppers can't judge size or look from a photo, which leads to hesitation and returns. AR Mart explores letting them see the product in place first.
